subject: English
passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• A material's critical temperature is the temperature below which it conducts electricity with zero resistance (becomes superconducting).
• When a material's critical temperature is confirmed to exceed 200 K, it is classified as a high-temperature superconductor.
• Lanthanum hydride (LaH10) is a hydrogen-rich compound.
• It was confirmed as a high-temperature superconductor in 2019.
• Carbonaceous sulfur hydride (CSH) is a hydrogen-rich compound.
• It was confirmed as a high-temperature superconductor in 2020.
prompt: The student wants to emphasize a similarity between lanthanum hydride and carbonaceous sulfur hydride. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

choices.A: Lanthanum hydride (LaH10), a hydrogen-rich compound, was confirmed as a high-temperature superconductor in 2019, unlike carbonaceous sulfur hydride (CSH), which would be confirmed later.
choices.B: The year was 2020, and carbonaceous sulfur hydride (CSH) had finally been confirmed as a high-temperature superconductor.
choices.C: Lanthanum hydride (LaH10), a hydrogen-rich compound, and carbonaceous sulfur hydride (CSH), also a hydrogen-rich compound, were both recently confirmed as high-temperature superconductors.
choices.D: Lanthanum hydride (LaH10) contains lanthanum, whereas carbonaceous sulfur hydride (CSH) contains carbon and sulfur.

explanation: Choice C is the best answer. The sentence emphasizes a similarity between lanthanum hydride and carbonaceous sulfur hydride by noting that both compounds were recently confirmed as high-temperature superconductors.
